title: LN executes x87 FLDLN2 + FYL2X and follows the host CPU vendor's FYL2X microcode on AMD vs Intel
statement: In Excel 16.0 builds 20131, 20228, 20430, and 20527 on AMD Ryzen 7 4800H, LN(x) returns #NUM! for x <= 0 and executes the hardware x87 FLDLN2 + FYL2X instruction pair stored to binary64. On 13 inputs from DnaCalc's x87 ground-truth table where AMD Ryzen 7 4800H and Intel Haswell hardware FYL2X differ by 1 ULP (and where software x87 agrees with Intel), Excel 16.0 build 20527 on AMD matches all 13 AMD hardware FYL2X results. All 1,685 full-bank LN rows match.
basis: Measured in CalcFunc-Evidence readings/excel-20527/LN.json and probes/2026-10-31-calcvba-run3/summary.json (Excel 16.0 build 20527 on AMD Ryzen 7 4800H, 13/13 LN vendor rows matched AMD FYL2X) plus 1,685/1,685 full-bank LN matches.
